entities.summary: Kwasi Ameyaw-Cheremeh is a Ghanaian politician and was the member of parliament for the Sunyani East constituency in the 5th, 6th, 7th and 8th parliament of the 4th republic. In February 2024, he was nominated as the presiding speaker of the Parliament of Ghana.
